title: Banana with Honey
description: Two ingredients. Not everything needs a method.
steps: Slice the banana onto a plate and pour the honey over.

title: Apple with Peanut Butter
description: Crunch and fat together, which is why it holds you longer than either alone.
steps: Core the apple and cut into wedges.
Serve with the peanut butter for dipping.

title: Greek Yoghurt with Berries
description: Twenty grams of protein in two minutes and one bowl.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl, add the berries and drizzle the honey over.

title: Hummus with Carrot Sticks
description: Cut a whole bag of carrots at once and it is a snack you will actually reach for.
steps: Cut the vegetables into sticks and store them upright in a container with a little water.
Serve with the hummus.

title: Cheese and Crackers
description: No method required.
steps: Slice the cheese and put it on the crackers.

title: Boiled Eggs
description: Boil six at the start of the week. Peeled or not, they keep three days and answer most snack questions.
steps: Lower the eggs into boiling water and cook 9 minutes for a firm yolk.
Cool under cold running water for a minute — it makes them far easier to peel.
Store unpeeled in the fridge.

title: Vegemite Toast
description: Butter first, then a scrape. Not a spread.
steps: Toast the bread, butter it while hot, then spread the vegemite thinly over the top.

title: Mixed Nuts
description: Portion them into small containers, or the whole bag disappears in one sitting.
steps: Mix and divide into four small containers of about 55 g each.

title: Tuna on Crackers
description: One tin, five minutes, a lot of protein.
steps: Mash the tuna with the mayonnaise and lemon juice.
Spoon onto the crackers.

title: Cottage Cheese with Tomato
description: Very high protein for the calories. Salt it properly or it tastes of nothing.
steps: Spoon the cottage cheese into a bowl and top with the tomato.
Add the oil, salt and plenty of pepper.

title: Avocado on Rice Cakes
description: Make it at the moment you eat it — avocado browns fast and rice cakes go soft faster.
steps: Mash the avocado with the lemon juice and salt.
Spread onto the rice cakes and scatter the chilli flakes over.

title: Yoghurt with Honey and Cinnamon
description: Three things, one bowl.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a bowl and add the honey and cinnamon.

title: Olives and Feta
description: Dress a container of it and it sits happily in the fridge for three days.
steps: Toss the feta and olives with the oil and oregano.
Leave 20 minutes before eating so the oregano softens.

title: Stovetop Popcorn
description: Costs a fraction of the packet kind. Salt it the second it comes off the heat.
steps: Heat the oil in a large pot with three kernels and the lid on.
When those three pop, add the rest, put the lid back on and shake the pot every few seconds.
Take it off the heat when the popping slows to one every few seconds.
Toss immediately with the melted butter and salt.

title: Tzatziki with Pita
description: Squeeze the cucumber hard or the dip turns watery by tomorrow.
steps: Salt the grated cucumber, leave 10 minutes, then squeeze out as much water as you can.
Mix with the yoghurt, garlic, dill, oil and lemon juice.
Serve with warm pita cut into strips.

title: Roasted Spiced Chickpeas
description: Crunchy and high fibre. Dry the chickpeas properly first, or they steam instead of crisping.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Dry the chickpeas thoroughly on a tea towel, rubbing off any loose skins.
Toss with the oil, spices and plenty of salt.
Roast 35 minutes, shaking the tray twice, until they rattle.
Cool completely before storing or they go soft.

title: Grilled Cheese Fingers
description: A toastie cut into strips, which somehow makes it a snack rather than a meal.
steps: Fill the bread with the cheese and butter the outsides.
Toast in a dry pan 3 minutes a side, then cut into fingers.

title: Salted Edamame
description: Five minutes from the freezer. High protein and hard to overeat.
steps: Boil the edamame in salted water for 4 minutes and drain.
Toss with the sesame oil, salt and sesame seeds while hot.

title: Apple and Cheddar
description: Sharp cheese against sweet apple. Better than either alone.
steps: Slice the apple and the cheese and eat them together.

title: Mango Yoghurt Smoothie
description: Frozen mango keeps it cold without watering it down with ice.
steps: Blend everything for a minute until smooth.
Loosen with more milk if it will not pour.

title: Rice Cakes with Peanut Butter and Banana
description: Three ingredients stacked in the order they are listed.
steps: Spread the peanut butter over the rice cakes, lay the banana on and drizzle the honey.

title: Hummus and Salad Pita Pocket
description: Five minutes, no cooking, and it travels in a bag without falling apart.
steps: Split the pita and spread the inside with hummus.
Fill with the carrot, cucumber and spinach.

title: Dark Chocolate and Almonds
description: Portion it out rather than eating from the block.
steps: Break the chocolate and divide it with the almonds into two small containers.

title: Cucumber and Feta Bites
description: Cucumber rounds topped with feta and mint. Assemble the morning you eat them.
steps: Lay the cucumber rounds out and top each with feta.
Scatter the mint over, add the oil and grind on pepper.

title: Ricotta and Honey Toast
description: Ricotta is mild enough that the honey and salt do all the work. Use both.
steps: Toast the bread and spread the ricotta thickly.
Drizzle the honey over, add a pinch of salt and the cinnamon.

title: Trail Mix
description: Mix a jar and portion it out. Loose in a bag it becomes a meal by accident.
steps: Combine everything in a jar.
Portion into six containers of about 65 g.

title: Prawn Cocktail Cups
description: Cooked prawns and a two-ingredient sauce in lettuce cups. One day only, as with all cooked seafood.
steps: Mix the mayonnaise, tomato sauce and lemon juice.
Fold the prawns through.
Spoon into lettuce cups and dust with the paprika.

title: Caprese Skewers
description: Tomato, mozzarella and basil on a stick. Dress them only when you serve.
steps: Thread a tomato, a basil leaf and a cube of mozzarella onto each small skewer.
Arrange on a plate and add the oil, vinegar and salt just before eating.

title: Guacamole with Corn Chips
description: Avocado browns within the hour whatever you do, so make only what will be eaten.
steps: Mash the avocado roughly with the lime juice and a lot of salt — leave it lumpy.
Fold the onion, tomato, coriander and chilli through.
Serve immediately with the corn chips.

title: Cheese Scrolls
description: Eight scrolls from one batch of scone dough. They keep two days and reheat in an oven.
steps: Heat the oven to 200°C. Rub the butter into the flour with a pinch of salt until it looks like breadcrumbs.
Stir in the milk and bring together into a soft dough. Do not knead it much.
Roll into a rectangle about 1 cm thick, spread thinly with the vegemite and scatter most of the cheese over.
Roll up from the long edge and cut into 8 rounds.
Sit them cut-side up on a tray, brush with egg, top with the remaining cheese and bake 20 minutes.

title: Yoghurt and Granola Cup
description: Add the granola at the last second or it goes soft.
steps: Spoon the yoghurt into a cup, scatter the granola over and add the honey.
